exposure: idiopathic oligohydramnios with amniotic fluid index (AFI) less than 5cm
cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women between 37 and 42 weeks of gestation, divided into 100 cases with AFI<5cm and 100 controls with normal AFI (5-25cm).
finding: Isolated oligohydramnios significantly increases the incidence of operative intervention and adversely affects foetal outcome, leading to higher rates of labour induction, emergency caesarean section, meconium-stained liquor, abnormal CTG, low birth weight, lower Apgar scores, and NICU admissions.
mod_finding: The incidence of requirement for emergency caesarean section was significantly higher in cases (61%) compared to controls (28%).
